history.administration_response: A summary of actions taken and supporting documents have been provided. In the light of the corrective actions taken to address the performance of the three United Nations country teams, the Development Coordination Office requests that the Board close this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that collective actions have been taken specifically to address the problems, that an opinion was provided by the regional director of the Development Coordination Office who appraised the performance of the country teams according to the rules then applicable and that, in accordance with the latest management and accountability framework, performance reviews of country teams are no longer conducted, as a result of which no further results could be followed up on at the current time, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
